usedFor: MailChimp holds audiences and subscribers, and LiveAgent keeps support customers, so “Add New Customer” can copy a subscriber.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” in MailChimp, then “Add New Customer” in LiveAgent
bestTemplate.why: Subscribers who write in later already exist in support, so replies start with their details on file.

watchOut: Unsubscribes are a trigger too, so keep “When a subscriber unsubscribes from an audience” away from “Add New Customer”.
